tools.name: check_token_safety
tools.description: Looks up a Solana token by mint address and returns a safety report built from third-party on-chain analysis: a 0 to 100 risk score (0 is lowest risk) with a risk level, whether the token shows honeypot or rug signals, whether liquidity is locked, whether the mint and freeze authorities are still ac

tools.name: get_token_holders
tools.description: Lists the largest holders of a Solana token by mint address with each holder's share of supply, a holder type label and a risk score, and reports whether wallets look linked through a common funder or frequent transfers (cluster flags), plus supply-concentration summary figures. Read-only and inform

tools.name: explain_risk_signals
tools.description: Returns plain-language definitions of the signals found in a token safety report: risk score bands, honeypot signal, liquidity lock, mint authority, freeze authority, holder concentration and wallet clusters, with what each one can and cannot show. Static reference text; makes no network lookup.
